name: KeypadLinc Countdown Timer
description: The countdown timer keypads, a KeypadLinc variant whose buttons choose how long the load stays on. Settings are for the whole device, so D1 is always 0x01.

valueTables.name: rampRate
valueTables.description: How long each ramp rate takes to go from off to full on.

valueTables.name: onOff
valueTables.description: Off and on, for a load or LED a record switches.

operatingFlags.name: noWarning
operatingFlags.label: No warning before the countdown ends
operatingFlags.description: The keypad gives no warning before its countdown ends.

operatingFlags.name: actsAsRelay
operatingFlags.label: Switch only, no dimming
operatingFlags.description: The keypad switches its load as a relay instead of dimming it.

operatingFlags.name: buttonFourForever
operatingFlags.label: Button 4 has no countdown
operatingFlags.description: Button 4 turns the load on with no countdown.

flagCommands.name: buttonFourOff
flagCommands.description: Sets button 4 to off. Insteon's documents describe 0x35 and 0x37 alike and don't say which bit each clears.

flagCommands.name: buttonFourOffAlternate
flagCommands.description: Sets button 4 to off. Insteon's documents describe 0x35 and 0x37 alike and don't say which bit each clears.

values.name: x10HouseCode
values.label: X10 house code
values.description: The X10 house code, or 0x20 for no X10 address.

values.name: rampRate
values.label: Ramp rate
values.description: The ramp rate, from 0x01 (8 minutes) to 0x1F (0.1 second). 0x00 is 2 seconds.

verification.note: The Insteon Developer's Guide gives ramp rates 0x00 through 0x1F as 9 minutes down to 0.1 second; the table uses the later reading, where 0x00 is 2 seconds.

values.name: onLevel
values.label: On-level
values.description: The level the load turns on to, from 0x00 (off) to 0xFF (full).

values.name: ledBrightness
values.label: LED brightness
values.description: The brightness of the status LEDs, from 0x11 (dimmest) to 0x7F (brightest).

values.name: timerHours
values.label: Timer hours
values.description: The countdown's hours, which also turn the timer on: 0x00 is off, 0x01 is on for the minutes and seconds alone, 0x02 for one hour plus the minutes and seconds, and so on.

values.name: timerLeds
values.label: Timer LEDs
values.description: The timer LEDs: bit 0 is 2 minutes, bit 1 5 minutes, bit 2 10 minutes, bit 3 15 minutes, bit 4 30 minutes, bit 5 1 hour, bit 6 2 hours and bit 7 4 hours.

values.name: x10AllMask
values.label: Buttons that send X10 all on and off
values.description: The buttons that send X10 All On or All Off instead of On or Off.

values.name: nonToggleOnMask
values.label: Non-toggle buttons that send on
values.description: The non-toggle buttons that send On. The others send Off.

values.name: triggerMask
values.label: Buttons that trigger another device's group
values.description: The trigger buttons, each of which sends a trigger command when pressed.

writes.name: countdown
writes.description: Sets the countdown (D3 seconds, D4 minutes, D5 hours) and the level the load turns on to (D6). A level of 0x00 keeps the local on-level when the load is off and leaves the level alone when it's on.

writes.name: ledBrightness
writes.description: Sets the brightness of the status LEDs.

writes.name: ledMask
writes.description: Turns the timer LEDs on and off.

writes.name: x10AllMask
writes.description: Sets which buttons send X10 All On or All Off.

writes.name: nonToggleOnMask
writes.description: Sets which non-toggle buttons send On.

writes.name: triggerMask
writes.description: Sets which buttons are trigger buttons.

standardCommands.name: lightOn
standardCommands.description: Turns the load on: a dimmer to the level in cmd2 at the saved ramp rate, an on/off model to full on.

parameter.name: onLevel
parameter.description: The level to go to, from 0x00 (off) to 0xFF (full).

standardCommands.name: lightOff
standardCommands.description: Turns the load off at the saved ramp rate.

standardCommands.name: readStatus
standardCommands.description: Reads the load's level. The acknowledgment's cmd1 carries the ALL-Link database delta.

reply.name: onLevel
reply.description: The load's level, from 0x00 (off) to 0xFF (full); an on/off model gives only 0x00 or 0xFF.

responder.name: onLevel
responder.label: On-level
responder.description: The level the group goes to when its controller's On arrives, 0x00 (off) to 0xFF (full). 0x00 makes the link off only.

verification.note: Read from the Insteon Developer's Guide, which gives Data 1 as the on-level and Data 2 as the ramp rate as examples, and from other dimmers' Developer Notes.

responder.name: rampRate
responder.label: Ramp rate
responder.description: How fast the group goes to its on-level.

verification.note: Read from the Insteon Developer's Guide, which gives Data 1 as the on-level and Data 2 as the ramp rate as examples, and from other dimmers' Developer Notes.

responder.name: onLevel
responder.label: On or off
responder.description: 0x00 turns the load off when the controller's On arrives, 0xFF on.

verification.note: Read from other on/off products' Developer Notes, which give Data 1 as the on-level; no document describes this product's records.

notes: Bits 2 and 3 of the 0x04 reply together SET button 4's mode: always off, always on, a 4-hour countdown or on/off toggle.
The keypad is built on the KeypadLinc code base, but Insteon's documents don't say which of the KeypadLinc's other operating flags it accepts.
Setting the hours and minutes starts the countdown, and the matching LED lights a second later.
